name: Megasuki! ~Kanojo to Boku no Megane Jijou~ Azumino G Sakurako Hen
original_name: メガスキ！ 〜彼女と僕の眼鏡事情〜 安曇野・G・桜子編
source:
Tooyama Wataru is all about baseball. Eventually, he's told that if he keeps failing his English tests, he'll be dropped from the team. That's where Azumino G. Sakurako comes in. Under her guidance, Wataru passes his tests one by one. And all the while, Sakurako finds herself falling for him.

[Translated from [url=http://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/glasses/megasuki2/sakurako.html]official website[/url]]
